13void test_133Ba_gamma_quiver()
14{
15    // Detector setup: whole-array total efficiency, conditional on gamma emission.
16    const double totalEfficiency = 0.7;
17    const std::size_t detectorCount = 64; // Set to the number of detectors in your array.
18
19    std::cout
20        << "============================================================"
21        << std::endl;
22
23    std::cout
24        << "             133Ba -> EC -> 133Cs decay quiver"
25        << std::endl;
26
27    std::cout
28        << "============================================================"
29        << std::endl;
30
31
32    // ========================================================

34    //
35    // 133Ba:
36    //     Z = 56
37    //     A = 133
38    // ========================================================
39
40    RadioactiveDecayReader radioactiveReader(
41        "RadioactiveDecay5.5"
42    );
43
44    RadioactiveIsotope ba133 =
45        radioactiveReader.read(56, 133);
46
47
48    // ========================================================
49    // Read photon evaporation data for the DAUGHTER nucleus
50    //
51    // 133Cs:
52    //     Z = 55
53    //     A = 133
54    // ========================================================
55
56    PhotonEvaporationReader photonReader(
57        "PhotonEvaporation5.5"
58    );
59
60    PhotonIsotope cs133 =
61        photonReader.read(55, 133);
62
63
64    // ========================================================
65    // Print radioactive decay information
66    // ========================================================
67
68    std::cout
69        << std::endl
70        << "133Ba radioactive decay data"
71        << std::endl;
72
73    std::cout
74        << "--------------------------------------------"
75        << std::endl;
76
77    std::cout
78        << "Atomic number  = "
79        << ba133.atomicNumber()
80        << std::endl;
81
82    std::cout
83        << "Mass number    = "
84        << ba133.massNumber()
85        << std::endl;
86
87    std::cout
88        << "Parent states  = "
89        << ba133.numberOfParentStates()
90        << std::endl;
91
92
93    // ========================================================
94    // Print PhotonEvaporation information
95    // ========================================================
96
97    std::cout
98        << std::endl
99        << "133Cs PhotonEvaporation data"
100        << std::endl;
101
102    std::cout
103        << "--------------------------------------------"
104        << std::endl;
105
106    std::cout
107        << "Atomic number  = "
108        << cs133.atomicNumber()
109        << std::endl;
110
111    std::cout
112        << "Mass number    = "
113        << cs133.massNumber()
114        << std::endl;
115
116    std::cout
117        << "Number of levels = "
118        << cs133.numberOfLevels()
119        << std::endl;
120
121
122    // ========================================================
123    // Build the gamma-decay quiver
124    //
125    // "EC" means physical electron capture, so the builder
126    // combines:
127    //
128    //     KshellEC
129    //     LshellEC
130    //     MshellEC
131    //
132    // from the Ba-133 radioactive-decay data.
133    //
134    // The resulting daughter levels and gamma transitions
135    // come from Cs-133 PhotonEvaporation data.
136    // ========================================================
137
138    std::unordered_map<std::string, double> conversionCoefficients;
139    DecayQuiver quiver =
140        DecayQuiverBuilder::BuildGammaQuiver(
141            ba133,
142            cs133,
143            conversionCoefficients,
144            "EC"
145        );
146
147
148    if (conversionCoefficients.size() != quiver.GetTransitions().size() ||
149        std::abs(conversionCoefficients.at("gamma_81_to_0_0") - 1.703) > 1e-12 ||
150        std::abs(conversionCoefficients.at("gamma_437_to_384_0") - 5.66) > 1e-12)
151        throw std::runtime_error("Incorrect extracted Ba-133 conversion coefficients");
152
153    // ========================================================
154    // Print resulting quiver
155    // ========================================================
156
157    std::cout
158        << std::endl
159        << "Resulting gamma-decay quiver:"
160        << std::endl
161        << std::endl;
162
163    quiver.Print();
164
165
166    // ========================================================
167    // Summary
168    // ========================================================
169
170    std::cout
171        << std::endl
172        << "--------------------------------------------"
173        << std::endl;
174
175    std::cout
176        << "Number of levels      = "
177        << quiver.GetLevels().size()
178        << std::endl;
179
180    std::cout
181        << "Number of transitions = "
182        << quiver.GetTransitions().size()
183        << std::endl;
184
185    std::cout
186        << "============================================================"
187        << std::endl;
188
189    // Probabilities:
190
191    DecayVector decay_vector;
192    // Builder names use six decimal places and the case-sensitive suffix keV.
193    const auto requireLevel = [&quiver](const std::string& name) {
194        DecayLevel* level = quiver.GetLevel(name);
195        if(level == nullptr)
196        {
197            throw std::runtime_error("Missing quiver level: " + name);
198        }
199        return level;
200    };
201    DecayLevel* e0 = requireLevel("level_0.000000keV");
202    DecayLevel* e1 = requireLevel("level_80.997900keV");
203    DecayLevel* e2 = requireLevel("level_160.612100keV");
204    DecayLevel* e3 = requireLevel("level_383.849100keV");
205    DecayLevel* e4 = requireLevel("level_437.011300keV");
206
207    DecayTransition* g10 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_81_to_0_0");
208    DecayTransition* g21 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_161_to_81_0");
209    DecayTransition* g20 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_161_to_0_1");
210    DecayTransition* g30 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_384_to_0_2");
211    DecayTransition* g31 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_384_to_81_1");
212    DecayTransition* g41 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_437_to_81_2");
213    DecayTransition* g32 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_384_to_161_0");
214    DecayTransition* g42 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_437_to_161_1");
215    DecayTransition* g43 = quiver.GetTransition("gamma_437_to_384_0");
216
217    DecayPath p0(e0);
218    DecayPath p1(e1);
219    DecayPath p2(e2);
220    DecayPath p3(e3);
221    DecayPath p4(e4);
222
223
224       // --------------------------------------------------------
225    // Stationary components
226    // --------------------------------------------------------
227
228    decay_vector.AddTerm(
229        p0,
230        0.0 //e0.GetProbability()
231    );
232
233    decay_vector.AddTerm(
234        p1,
235        0.0 //e1.GetProbability()
236    );
237
238    decay_vector.AddTerm(
239        p2,
240        0.0 // e2.GetProbability()
241    );
242
243    decay_vector.AddTerm(
244        p3,
245        0.145 //e3.GetProbability()
246    );
247
248    decay_vector.AddTerm(
249        p4,
250        0.855 //e4.GetProbability()
251    );
252
253     // --------------------------------------------------------
254    // Length-one components
255    // --------------------------------------------------------
256
257    for(const auto* transition :
258        quiver.GetTransitions())
259    {
260        DecayPath path(*transition);
261
262        decay_vector.AddTerm(
263            path,
264            path.GetProbability()
265        );
266    }
267    PathAlgebra algebra(quiver);
268    PathProjectors projectors;
269    DecayProbability pb(algebra,projectors);
270    DecayVector feedingVector = pb.FeedingVector(decay_vector);
271    std::cout << "Total transition feeding (gamma + IC):\n";
272    feedingVector.PrintTable();
273    std::cout << "Gamma emission feeding:\n";
274    pb.EmissionFeedingVector(decay_vector, conversionCoefficients).PrintTable();
275
276    std::vector<double> initialPopulations(quiver.GetLevels().size(), 0.0);
277    for(const auto& term:decay_vector.GetTerms()) if(term.path.IsStationary())
278        for(std::size_t i=0;i<quiver.GetLevels().size();++i)
279            if(term.path.GetSource()==quiver.GetLevels()[i]) initialPopulations[i]+=term.coefficient;
280    quiver.ExportJson("examples/133Ba_gamma_quiver.json",
281                      {decay_vector}, "133Ba -> EC -> 133Cs",
282                      conversionCoefficients, initialPopulations);
283
284    std::unordered_map<std::string, double> efficiencies;
285    efficiencies["gamma_81_to_0_0"] = 0.455954;
286    efficiencies["gamma_161_to_81_0"] = 0.455949;
287    efficiencies["gamma_161_to_0_1"] = 0.40154;
288    efficiencies["gamma_384_to_0_2"] = 0.239605;
289    efficiencies["gamma_384_to_81_1"] = 0.283232;
290    efficiencies["gamma_437_to_81_2"] = 0.253294;
291    efficiencies["gamma_384_to_161_0"] = 0.34334284;
292    efficiencies["gamma_437_to_161_1"] = 0.30135745;
293    efficiencies["gamma_437_to_384_0"] = 0.44011142;
294
295    DecayVector feedingEfficiencyVector = pb.DetectionFeedingVector(decay_vector, efficiencies, conversionCoefficients);
296    std::cout << "Gamma detection feeding (including IC):\n";
297    feedingEfficiencyVector.PrintTable();
298    for (const auto& term : feedingVector.GetTerms())
299    {
300        const double expected = term.coefficient *
301            efficiencies.at(term.path.GetTransitions().front().GetName()) /
302            (1.0 + conversionCoefficients.at(term.path.GetTransitions().front().GetName()));
303        const double actual = algebra.PathForm(
304            feedingEfficiencyVector, DecayVector(term.path, 1.0));
305        if (std::abs(actual - expected) > 1e-12)
306            throw std::runtime_error("Incorrect detected feeding probability");
307    }
308    std::unordered_map<std::string, double> totalEfficiencies;
309    for (const auto* transition : quiver.GetTransitions())
310        totalEfficiencies[transition->GetName()] = totalEfficiency;
311
312    {
313        std::cout << "Summing setup: " << detectorCount
314                  << " detector(s), uniform whole-array total efficiency = "
315                  << totalEfficiency << '\n';
316        DetectionMaps maps(efficiencies, totalEfficiencies, detectorCount, conversionCoefficients);
317        const auto summed = pb.SummingFeedingVector(decay_vector, maps);
318        std::cout << "Connected summing contributions (separate paths):\n";
319        summed.PrintTable();
320        DecayVector peaks;
321        for (const auto* transition : quiver.GetTransitions()) {
322            DecayPath path(*transition);
323            peaks.AddTerm(path, algebra.PathForm(summed, DecayVector(path)));
324        }
325        std::cout << "Connected summing-corrected peaks (equivalent endpoints combined):\n";
326        peaks.PrintTable();
327
328    }
329
330    // ========================================================
331    // Coincidence vectors: physical, emitted, detected, summed
332    // ========================================================
333    // The fiber contains physical gamma+IC branches. Applying hit maps to
334    // observed factors must not also suppress the unobserved connections.
335    CAlgebra coins(quiver, {e4,e3,e2,e1,e0}, decay_vector);
336    DecayVector branch, tau;
337    for (const auto& term : decay_vector.GetTerms()) {
338        if (term.path.IsStationary()) branch.AddTerm(term.path,term.coefficient);
339        else tau.AddTerm(term.path,term.coefficient);
340    }
341    const DecayVector terminal(p0);
342    DetectionMaps maps(efficiencies,totalEfficiencies,detectorCount,conversionCoefficients);
343    DetectionMaps::EfficiencyMap unity;
344    for (const auto* edge : quiver.GetTransitions()) unity[edge->GetName()]=1.0;
345    // Unit conditional efficiency leaves only the gamma-emission fraction.
346    DetectionMaps emissionMap(unity,unity,detectorCount,conversionCoefficients);
347
348    // Transition-identity gate projector: retain terms containing ALL requested
349    // arrows, without changing or renormalizing their coefficients. This is the
350    // single-arrow form of G1/G2 (Eqs. 65/67), retaining parallel-arrow identity.
351    // On summed vectors this is photon membership, NOT a resolved-energy gate.
352    const auto gate = [](const CAlgebra::Vector& vector,
353                         const std::vector<DecayTransition*>& required) {
354        CAlgebra::Vector result;
355        for (const auto& term : vector) {
356            const auto& factors=term.coin.GetFactors();
357            const bool keep=std::all_of(required.begin(),required.end(),[&](const auto* edge) {
358                if (!edge) throw std::runtime_error("Missing coincidence gate transition");
359                return std::find(factors.begin(),factors.end(),DecayPath(*edge))!=factors.end();
360            });
361            if (keep) result.push_back(term);
362        }
363        return result;
364    };
365    const auto sum = [](const CAlgebra::Vector& vector) {
366        double result=0;
367        for (const auto& term : vector) result+=term.coefficient;
368        return result;
369    };
370    const auto print = [&](const std::string& title,const CAlgebra::Vector& vector) {
371        std::cout << "\n" << title << "\ncoefficient per parent decay | degree | coincidence basis\n";
372        if (vector.empty()) std::cout << "0 (zero vector)\n";
373        for (const auto& term : vector)
374            std::cout << std::setprecision(12) << term.coefficient << " | "
375                      << term.coin.Degree() << " | " << term.coin.ToString() << '\n';
376        std::cout << "Coefficient sum = " << sum(vector)
377                  << " (expected count; not generally an exclusive probability)\n";
378    };
379    std::cout << "\nCOINCIDENCE RESPONSE: illustrative existing peak efficiencies, total="
380              << totalEfficiency << ", N=" << detectorCount << ". IC included.\n"
381              << "All nonzero orders are printed; forbidden combinations have coefficient zero.\n"
382              << "Stationary markers retain initial populations; no factorial or reverse-order duplication.\n";
383    CAlgebra::Vector pairs;
384    for (std::size_t k=2;k<quiver.GetLevels().size();++k) {
385        auto physical=coins.Multiply(coins.Embed(branch),coins.Power(coins.Embed(tau),k));
386        if (physical.empty()) break;
387        if (k==2) pairs=physical;
388        const auto emitted=emissionMap.FullEnergyHit(physical);
389        const auto detected=maps.FullEnergyHit(physical);
390        const auto label=std::to_string(k)+"-transition ";
391        print(label+"physical coincidences (gamma + IC)",physical);
392        print(label+"gamma emission coincidences",emitted);
393        print(label+"independent full-energy detections (no summing corrections)",detected);
394        print(label+"emission, G1: contains 80.9979-keV gamma",gate(emitted,{g10}));
395        print(label+"detection, G1: contains 80.9979-keV gamma",gate(detected,{g10}));
396    }
397
398    // Eq. (70): one detector's peaks, including disconnected summed-in photons.
399    CAlgebra out(quiver,{e4,e3,e2,e1,e0},maps.SummingOut(tau));
400    const auto spectrum=out.Multiply(out.Multiply(out.Embed(branch),
401        maps.SummingInExpansion(out,tau)),out.Embed(terminal));
402    print("Summing-corrected spectrum: degree 1 singles; degree >=2 same-detector sums",spectrum);
403    print("Summed spectrum, G1 photon membership: includes 80.9979-keV gamma (not an 81-keV peak gate)",
404          gate(spectrum,{g10}));
405    print("Summed spectrum, G2 photon membership: includes 356.0134- and 80.9979-keV gammas",
406          gate(spectrum,{g41,g10}));
407
408    // Resolved two-detector peaks: all other radiation must avoid BOTH detectors.
409    // This does not implement general gated sums of photon groups (see CA-002).
410    CAlgebra::Vector cleanPairs;
411    if (detectorCount>=2) {
412        CAlgebra twoOut(quiver,{e4,e3,e2,e1,e0},maps.AvoidDetectors(tau,2));
413        cleanPairs=twoOut.Multiply(twoOut.Multiply(twoOut.Embed(branch),
414            twoOut.Power(twoOut.Embed(maps.FullEnergyHit(tau)),2)),twoOut.Embed(terminal));
415        for (auto& term : cleanPairs)
416            term.coefficient*=double(detectorCount-1)/double(detectorCount);
417    }
418    print("Two distinct clean full-energy peaks, including summing-out (no summed-in groups)",cleanPairs);
419    print("Clean pairs, G1: 80.9979-keV peak",gate(cleanPairs,{g10}));
420    print("Clean pairs, G2: 356.0134-keV AND 80.9979-keV peaks",gate(cleanPairs,{g41,g10}));
421
422    // Independent checks against the existing ordered path-probability API
423    // and explicit response factors for this adjacent two-transition pair.
424    const double physicalPair=sum(gate(pairs,{g41,g10}));
425    const double pathPair=pb.CoincidenceProbability(decay_vector,DecayPath(*g41),DecayPath(*g10));
426    const double gammaPair=physicalPair/(1+conversionCoefficients.at(g41->GetName()))/
427                                          (1+conversionCoefficients.at(g10->GetName()));
428    const double detectedPair=gammaPair*efficiencies.at(g41->GetName())*efficiencies.at(g10->GetName());
429    const auto check = [](double actual,double expected) {
430        if (std::abs(actual-expected)>1e-12)
431            throw std::runtime_error("Incorrect Ba-133 coincidence vector or gate");
432    };
433    check(physicalPair,pathPair);
434    check(sum(gate(emissionMap.FullEnergyHit(pairs),{g41,g10})),gammaPair);
435    check(sum(gate(maps.FullEnergyHit(pairs),{g41,g10})),detectedPair);
436    // This pair spans the full cascade from the populated top level to ground:
437    // there are no hidden photons, so only distinct-detector acceptance remains.
438    check(sum(gate(cleanPairs,{g41,g10})),detectedPair*double(detectorCount-1)/double(detectorCount));
439    check(sum(gate(spectrum,{g41,g10})),detectedPair/double(detectorCount));
440    check(sum(gate(gate(pairs,{g10}),{g10})),sum(gate(pairs,{g10})));
441    check(sum(gate(pairs,{g41,g43})),0.0); // mutually exclusive outgoing branches
442    std::cout << "PASS: Ba-133 coincidence response, clean/summed pair and gate checks\n";
443
